newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina donates building for Palestine mission.
newsitem.headline: Argentina donates building for Palestine mission.

text.p: The Argentine government has donated a building for the Palestine National Authority's delegation, the mission head said on Thursday.

"This shows once again the generosity of President (Carlos) Menem and his good disposition towards both Palestine and Israel here in Argentina," said Suhail Hani Daher Akel, who heads the local mission of the Palestine Authority and the Palestine Liberation Organisation.

He told Reuters the donation of the building was in response to a request by Palestinian President Yasser Arafat. An Argentine government spokesman could not confirm the announcement, saying he was waiting for official news.

"Let this be an example to show that peace is possible," Akel said. The Palestine Authority mission received full status in January but it lacked a building of its own and was functioning out of Akel's residence.
